superseded_because: This draft named 36 episodes, an M46 control, and init_inside_recovery. The launch contract is 72 logical jobs, M47 candidate versus M44 current on the M47 recovery core, with INIT 100 kept separate from MAIN 1000.
why_drafted: Fresh nominal is promising on RC100 (one published cross sortie, nominal cost 542.474 versus fresh S 670.123 and sealed M46 X 564.680) and on C100 nominal cost and air (321.946, 82 air) without a surviving cross. No actual SERVICE has been observed.

bound.why_not_180: 6 maps x 10 dev seeds x 3 arms would be 180. That grid is not authorized by this draft.

roles.S: Fresh M47 S nominal, which matched strong K1 exactly on plan, cost, and H. Recovery policy S.
roles.R: Exact clone of that fresh S nominal. Recovery policy X. No separate nominal optimization and no extra nominal budget.
roles.X: Fresh M47 X nominal from the same run. Recovery policy X.
roles.current_control: Sealed M46 X nominal, same map, same dev seed, same H.
roles.strong_K1: Sealed K1 S nominal and its H_s. Already shown equal to fresh S.

H: Per map, the fresh S H_s, which equals sealed K1 S H_s. Not X's own z+1800.

budgets.nominal_already_paid_in_fresh: S and X each already spent their own <=1000 physical and <=200 scenario. Do not rerun nominal inside the actual batch.

worlds.rule: Use only already recorded dev witnesses for seeds 1001 and 1002. Do not sample, do not drop a map after seeing a result, do not open 4001-4030 or 270701.
missing_from_this_package: Recorded dev world flags for case_1001_S and case_1002_S under the historical J2/executions/own/dev layout named by reference_only_actual_harness/M41/fresh_actual.py
The harness still imports an M41 core path that is not this M47 core

dedup: One new execution file per (map, seed, arm). Refuse to overwrite. R is not a second nominal solve. Startup nominal verification is one charged physical call per canonical plan, not per duplicate arm, and is ledged apart from recovery.
